name: 未設定の状態から更新できる目標の状態カード
prompt: Recreate only the compact Asana latest-status card shown in the primary crop. The source card is 575 × 126 px, about 4.56:1. Keep a shallow landscape card with the same soft rounded corners, fine light-gray outline, white background, and no surrounding page, adjacent progress card, or outside padding. Center three lines vertically and horizontally: small muted 「最新の状態」; a larger bold muted-gray status row with one thin hollow gray circle followed by 「状態なし」; then a smaller blue text action 「状態を設定」. Preserve the source's empty/no-status state and light, neutral visual hierarchy. Match original card proportions, spacing and regular Meiryo-style Japanese typography. Do not add a filled status icon, progress indicator, date, or other content. The original crop controls geometry, icon state, colors and empty value; the Japanese mock supplies localized labels only. Use the source blue action, not the mock green. Raster candidate only; no native editability or application behavior claim.
reviewNotes: The label, hollow-circle No status value, and blue Set status action match the source and Japanese mock. Candidate is 2170x725 (2.99:1) versus the 575x126 (4.56:1) source card; the card is surrounded by extensive vertical canvas whitespace. Preserve as needs-correction. Exact typography, native editability and application behavior are unverified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
